mapper.insert: INSERT INTO consignment_unpost (store, sku, sales_qty, sales_return_qty, sales_date, source_type, source_ref, is_settled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{store}, #{sku}, #{salesQty}, #{salesReturnQty}, #{salesDate}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceRef}, false, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT store, sku, SUM(sales_qty) AS total_sales, SUM(sales_return_qty) AS total_return FROM consignment_unpost WHERE is_settled = false AND store = #{store} AND sales_date >= #{fromDate} AND sales_date <= #{toDate} GROUP BY store, sku ORDER BY store, sku
